title: Expose 112 funded native helper queries with exact return decoding
body:
The center-free native producer has useful information inside its already-paid helper history, but endpoint-only access does not expose it. This package supplies an explicit forward interface: 112 existing H1 children yield a common rank-one Gaussian Q on 112 independent helper input coordinates, with an invertible basis and return decoding for all 358 cold helpers. All 632 source endpoint rows are checked, and the coded main endpoint is unchanged.

The query observations need no added Gaussian call or split. Completing and decoding the helper returns does cost **26 H5 + six H1**: the cold target bank becomes 358 H9, while all 50 hot-helper jobs retain their original targets. The 112 observations receive no productive credit. The proof lists owned storage, scalar and monomial work, exact phases, chronological availability and the all-width argument.

This is an intermediate forward interface, **not a complete caller, new exponent, or completed donor objective**. Main-input embedding with restoration of displaced helpers, backward/inverse interfaces actually used by a caller, and the full precision/storage/outer budget remain open. The continuing investigation is coordinated in [Discussion #4930](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4930#discussioncomment-19154057).

Validation at commit `013f6554577e33dea83c2ecdfa9fe2a810932b15`:

- Registered Python 3.12.15 normal and `-O` replays pass: all 632 endpoint rows, all 358 scalar basis inputs, 112 signed-tableau plus absolute-phase response identities and 32 completion identities.
- Four controls reject main-input contamination, a singular basis, a tableau-invisible wrong phase and a missing completion.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight passes for 16 files; committed export integrity and direct replay in a fresh exported directory also pass.

Submission checkpoint: canonical main `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4`, priority 7, selected conditional κ=.0030217758. Live overlap checked 2026-10-23 with complete pagination of 333 open PRs and 4673 discussion records; coverage is recorded as a search, not proof of novelty. Scientific inputs retain the earlier `a5df48c55ea806d7952b65acc9c76d878ff09b13` freeze and explicit `7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56` manifest baseline; those inputs are unchanged on submission main.

Credit: Cao Yifan/intqwq's #4610 native word; Dugongue/mdumitrean's #4929 center-free producer; Cinna Davis/1337isnot1337's #4694/#4698 helper lineage; Dillon/dillona's #4933 exact normalizers and #5126 scoped query bound; Chris R/Clear1nsight's #4931 source-history control; zxv's #5283 cache-reuse criteria; and the retained native, Clifford, compiler and precision contributors. Full attribution is in the package. Prepared for Dillon with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.
